# polaris_namespace (Resource)

Manages a namespace in a Polaris catalog. Nested namespaces need their parent to exist: reference the parent resource. A namespace can only be destroyed once it is empty.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_namespace" "sales" {
  catalog   = "lakehouse"
  namespace = ["sales"]

  properties = {
    "owner" = "sales-analytics"
  }
}

# Nested namespace: reference the parent so it is created first.
resource "polaris_namespace" "sales_eu" {
  catalog   = polaris_namespace.sales.catalog
  namespace = concat(polaris_namespace.sales.namespace, ["eu"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The name of the catalog. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace path as an ordered list of levels, e.g. `["sales", "eu"]`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `location` (String) Storage location of the namespace. Polaris sets it to `<catalog default_base_location>/<namespace path>/` when unset. Setting another value requires the `ALLOW_NAMESPACE_CUSTOM_LOCATION` feature on the server. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current location.
- `properties` (Map of String) Namespace properties. The storage location is managed with `location` and must not be set here.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a namespace by catalog and namespace path, levels separated by "/".
terraform import polaris_namespace.sales_eu lakehouse/sales/eu
```
